## Design

### 2026-10-12 – October 12: Started merbl and learned Onshape

**1.48h**

October 12: Started merbl and learned Onshape

I began by watching an Onshape Tutorial for Absolute Beginners on Youtube and played around with the different tools (I forgot to start Lapse during this). I learned where the buttons were and create a 3d part using extrude, cut, and revolve.
(Photo of the tutorial's part, mine looked pretty much like this too)
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/WyN6YOeG4UtFVFQxcC7rI7Awh9i5F6xj/de968a72959bbd9fd82f749479eda149c355330187b2f46252c11d739849106b.png)

Then I began following the merbl guide. I started by drawing the regular track, creating composite curves and sweeping the track shape along the curves. After this initial test of creating tracks, I moved on to creating a plinko track. I mostly followed the guide but it was pretty similar to working in Solidworks so I completed it on my own.

So today I just started creating some different types of tracks on Onshape. I'll finish the guide and start working on the actual track later.

[Timelapse](https://lookout.hackclub.com/api/media/2305bc5a-38b1-470b-a85c-a052b90ad93d/video.mp4)

### 2026-10-13 – October 13: Staircase Track, Funnel, and Archimedes Screw

**0.53h**

October 13: Staircase Track, Funnel, and Archimedes Screw

Finished up with the guide by creating a staircase track and funnel on Onshape. I got curious about the design with a motor and Archimedes screw, so I created an Archimedes screw on Onshape as well. Now, I think I'll start designing the actual track and begin assembling it on Onshape.

[Timelapse](https://lookout.hackclub.com/api/media/c25b3bc4-5163-4a33-bf78-1e64d9337cda/video.mp4)

### 2026-10-15 – October 15: worked on the track assembly

**0.83h**

October 15: worked on the track assembly

I started by expanding my track I had from the previous day, adding more loops and turns. After completing that, I started adding everything into an assembly. I took the parts that I previously made (funnel, plinko track, and staircase track (though I did end up removing the staircase track)) and moved them to roughly the position I want them in. I haven't mated anything together yet, though.

[Timelapse](https://lookout.hackclub.com/api/media/9bf18db6-306b-4de1-b471-07e92b4ec982/video.mp4)

### 2026-10-16 – October 16: finished merbl track!

**2.43h**

October 16: finished merbl track!

I finished up my merbl track and placed all components in an assembly. I finished it off by positioning everything correctly and adding a small dome to collect the marble at the end of the track.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/WyN6YOeG4UtFVFQxcC7rI7Awh9i5F6xj/76acd58236a547de1ece8fe06ae28c536050d6f0ea784d008fea9898cd5ab4e1.png)

After finishing, I decided to start a new design on Solidworks. This time, I wanted to try making a modular marble track. So I began by creating a base, a support, a straight connector and a curved connector. I will try to add more parts (the actual rail) later and add connections between the parts. I ended off the work session by mating some of the components together in an assembly to see how they fit.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/WyN6YOeG4UtFVFQxcC7rI7Awh9i5F6xj/8c45b8453a704258b6571dc4b1a729724067958de1a4c7efbc30fd7b40c370d3.png)
